engineBuild.main: make wasm with origin/main production sources temporarily substituted in this worktree; STABILEO_GIT_COMMIT set to originMain; sources and original WASM restored in finally
engineBuild.fixed: make wasm from the final round 8 engine sources; re-run every recorded exact argument using scripts/tests/arc-evidence-equilibrium.mjs --update

scope: WASM records contain exact positional arguments and selected returned fields. All warning/diagnostic fields throughout each response are retained in notices, including empty arrays. Unlisted output fields are not claimed equal.

For replay, initialize web/src/lib/wasm/dedaliano_engine.js, then call engine[record.method](...record.arguments); parse string results as JSON. Refusals are caught and retained. Build main and fixed WASM separately from their recorded sources.
Release boundaries are source/tag inspection, not released-binary replay. Path presence does not mean every fixture was accepted in every release.
Guyan 3D, native continuation and native per-step displacements have no corresponding WASM export; native regression outcomes are recorded separately.
Time history already warns about #760. The undetermined 3D stiffness-free stage already refuses. Existing warnings in other sweep fixtures are retained; the entire sweep is not claimed silent.
